completionMarker.rule: sha256 of the concatenated shasum lines of the manifest, the tile index and the identity report, in that order, written once with set -C so a second run cannot overwrite it

encoding.absentBlockMeaning: nothing in the block at all, which is not the same as nothing countable
encoding.block: dx uint8, dy uint8, countable uint16, mapped uint16, forest uint16 x 38, loss uint16 x 38, pairCount uint16, then pairCount x (first uint8, second uint8, count uint16)
encoding.header: magic 4, tileX uint16, tileY uint16, blockCount uint16
